- Webinar: we can commit a Redwood product speaker (ops-focused) and will provide a one-pager for promotion.
- Staffing: we can commit 1 Redwood rep per city contingent on travel approvals (Ben/People ops to confirm).

Next steps I propose:

2) EdgeWorks to send a short LOI / MDF outline so Legal/Finance can review.
3) We'll draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and promotional responsibilities.
